items.article: The first 12 stations of Pune Metro Line 3, covering the 13-km Maan to R K Laxman Museum stretch, are ready for operations after receiving provisional CMRS authorisation on July 23. Sakalnagar, University, RBI and District Court are the four remaining stations. PMRDA is completing the work and preparing to upload the required data for CMRS inspection and safety clearance. Around 96.5% of the Metro Line 3 project has been completed. Minor staircase-related work is still underway at some of the 12 completed stations before the operational stretch is formally inaugurated. The safety clearance process for the four remaining stations is likely to begin soon, with the required details being uploaded. Once CMRS approval is received, the stations will be added to the operational section. The formal inauguration date for the operational stretch has not been announced. PMRDA officials have sought a date, while the authorities are yet to confirm the schedule for starting operations. The Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Metro project spans 23.3 km and has faced several delays. Its latest completion deadline has been extended to March 31, 2027, while the remaining stations are expected to open in phases. PMRDA had proposed making all 23 stations operational by December 2026. The concession extension proposal until March 2027 is intended to provide additional time for residual civil works and other project obligations.

CHANDIGARH: A joyous new chapter has begun in the family of former cricketer and The Great Indian Kapil Show fame Navjot Singh Sidhu. Sidhu has become a grandfather as his son Karan Sidhu and daughter-in-law Inayat welcomed a baby girl into their lives. Sidhu shared the happy news with his fans on social media, revealing that his granddaughter was born on October 1, 2026. He also announced her beautiful name: Arya Sidhu. Sharing a special poster on Instagram, Navjot Singh Sidhu announced the arrival of the newest member of the family. The news quickly spread across social media, with fans and celebrities showering the Sidhu family with congratulatory messages and blessings. A post shared by Navjot Singh Sidhu (@navjotsinghsidhu) The announcement also sparked curiosity about the meaning of the baby’s name. Arya is derived from the Sanskrit word “ arya “, which is associated with meanings such as noble, respectable and honoured. In Sanskrit and Hindu religious traditions, Arya is also used as an epithet associated with Goddess Parvati.
